device.description: 12-bit multiplying current-output DAC with 50 MHz serial interface, daisy-chain and read-back
device.note: dac7811.pdf (SBAS337E) p.1 power-on zero scale, p.3 pin functions, p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.5 interface timing, p.13 serial interface, input shift register, SYNC interrupt, daisy-chain, p.14 Figure 28 timing and Table 2 control bits

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; powers on at zero scale (p.1, p.14)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: daisy-chain disabled (C3-C0 = 1001) and rising-edge clock mode (1010); power-on: daisy-chain on, falling edge (p.14)

commands.name: Initiate readback
commands.note: DAC register contents on SDO in the next frame (word layout not given; control nibble output as 0)

protocol.note: 16-bit word C3-C0 + DB11-DB0, MSB first (Figure 27, Table 2); executed at SYNC rising in daisy-chain mode (power-on default) or at the 16th active edge in stand-alone mode; reserved codes ignored

pages: p.1 (power-on zero scale), p.3 (pins), p.4 (VDD 2.7-5.5 V), p.5 (timing, tDDS 35 ns), p.13 (serial interface, SYNC interrupt, daisy-chain), p.14 (Figure 28: SCLK idles high, data in on falling edges; Table 2 control bits)
notModeled: analog: multiplying current outputs IOUT1/IOUT2, VREF, feedback resistor RFB
daisy-chain SDO: in daisy-chain mode SDO shifts out the previous 16-bit input word (to the next device); the model drives SDO only with a readback word (otherwise 0)

stand-alone vs daisy-chain execution point: modeled for both as the last 16 bits before SYNC rises (align end); stand-alone mode executes at the 16th falling edge and ignores further clocks, and a SYNC rise before 16 edges aborts the frame (both ignored only as far as align end allows)
rising-edge clock mode (C3-C0 = 1010) is stored in CTRL.EDGE but the bus stays mode 2 (falling-edge input)
readback word layout on SDO is not given in the datasheet (modeled as 0000 + DB11-DB0)
